description: List the datasets in the monity.ai account: rows Monity collects from one or many pages and keeps up to date. Each has its uuid, what it collects, its pages, how often it runs, the newest run with rows (row count, new/changed/gone) and whether a run is going now. Use the uuid with get_dataset_rows and get_dataset_changes; run_monitor with the same uuid collects it again, and pause_monitor, resume_monitor and delete_monitor take it too (a dataset is a task).

workspaceId.description: Only this workspace (default: every workspace of the account you can see)

name: list_datasets
title: List datasets
